listing.name: Lost Odyssey Recomp
listing.summary: Upstream v1.1.0 publishes Windows x86-64, Linux x86-64, Apple Silicon and Android ARM64 packages. The upstream importer opens when game data is missing. Import Disc 1 to start, then use Settings → System → Import discs & DLC to add more discs later.
